annotations.description: BYEs are failing (481/408) in zone east — teardown regression, typically after an SBC flip (in-dialog BYE landing on an SBC/FS that no longer knows the dialog). Check Homer for 481 on BYE in this zone and compare against the active-SBC election row. Affected channels will hang until RTP timeout (60s) or the session timer (<=30m); the dialog side ages out at the 2h dialog timeout. Runbook: docs/SBC_ACTIVE_STANDBY_RUNBOOK.md.
